mapper.sql: select task_id, task_name, task_type, command, prompt, skill, params, device_id, hosts, cron_expression, permission_cap, timeout_min, status, last_run_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from itm_sched_task
mapper.insert: insert into itm_sched_task (task_name, task_type, command, prompt, skill, params, device_id, hosts, cron_expression, permission_cap, timeout_min, status, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{taskName}, #{taskType}, #{command}, #{prompt}, #{skill}, #{skillParams}, #{deviceId}, #{hosts}, #{cronExpression}, #{permissionCap}, #{timeoutMin}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from itm_sched_task where task_id in #{id}
